source_documents.title: Electrochemical Annulation of Phenothiazines with Alkynes: Access to Anti-Kasha Triple-Emission, Light-Sensitive, and Room-Temperature Phosphorescent Materials

reference_evidence_units.quote: Theoretical calculations reveal that compound 3a exhibits two relatively large energy gaps between adjacent excited states, with ΔE values of 0.67 eV for S3 → S2 and 0.55 eV for S2 → S1 (Scheme 1).
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a

reference_evidence_units.quote: They exhibit obvious triple-emission, and their emission wavelengths are located in the range of blue to orange (417−605 nm) in dichloromethane (Figure S7).
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a-3i

reference_evidence_units.quote: In addition, compound 3a still exhibits distinct triple-emission peaks at 407 (τ = 1.06 ns), 473 (τ = 5.24 ns), and 564 nm (τ = 4.53 ns) with the white-light CIE1931 coordinates (0.34, 0.37) and a quantum yield of 5% in the poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) film (0.02 wt %) (Figure S12, Tables S4 and S5).
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a
reference_evidence_units.statement: Triple emission persists in the film; in DCM the bands are at 419, 502 and 587 nm (QY 19%).

reference_evidence_units.quote: These experiments demonstrate that such compounds exhibit anti-Kasha behavior
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a, 3b
reference_evidence_units.statement: The band ratios depend on excitation wavelength: emission from S3 and S2 as well as S1.

reference_evidence_units.quote: singlet state emission (S2 → S0, 3a: f = 0.0700; 3b: f = 0.0046), and the shortest wavelength from high-lying singlet state emission (S3 → S0, 3a: f = 0.4853; 3b: f = 1.0754, Figure 1).
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a, 3b
reference_evidence_units.statement: Oscillator strengths assigned to the S2 and S3 emissions (S1: 0.69 for both).

reference_evidence_units.quote: The relatively large energy gap ΔE(S3 → S2) values (3a: 0.67 eV, 3b: 0.48 eV) and ΔE(S2 → S1) values (3a: 0.55 eV, 3b: 0.78 eV) could effectively inhibit the partial internal conversion (IC) processes from the S3 to S2 state and from the
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a, 3b
reference_evidence_units.statement: Large gaps slow internal conversion between the upper singlets.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This inhibition enables the fluorescence emission from the S3 and S2 states to compete favorably with the IC
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a, 3b
reference_evidence_units.statement: Radiative decay of S3 and S2 competes with slowed internal conversion.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The paper explains the triple emission by state energetics: large S3-S2 and S2-S1 gaps slow internal conversion so that radiative decay from S3 and S2 competes (with the computed oscillator strengths); anti-Kasha emission itself is recorded out of pool.

contrast_group.varied_factor: heteroaryl annulated to 10-methylphenothiazine with diphenylacetylene (pyridine-derived quinolizinium vs benzothiazole-derived thiazolopyridinium)
contrast_group.paper_difference: Both show S3, S2 and S1 emission; the computed gaps differ (S3-S2 0.67 vs 0.48 eV, S2-S1 0.55 vs 0.78 eV) and so do the S2/S3 oscillator strengths.
